dedupe_keys.name: uganda communications commission mobile quality of service reports 2017 to 2024

description: The Uganda Communications Commission monitors the quality of mobile voice and data services and publishes the findings. The page lists reports from the 2017 to 2018 mobile voice performance report to the August to September 2024 assessment, including findings for mobile voice telephony and data services in 2021 and 2022. The assessments report key performance indicators such as call setup success, dropped calls, speech quality and data throughput by operator and by district or route tested, against the thresholds of the commission's quality of service framework. Coverage: Uganda, by operator and area tested, several rounds a year in some years. Format and access: PDF reports on the UCC website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: test routes and methods vary between rounds; results are in tables inside PDFs; the reports were not read in full, so the indicator list is partly inferred. Simulation uses: service performance baselines by operator and area for resilience and capacity studies of Ugandan mobile networks. Related records: data-ucc-uganda-market-performance-reports gives subscriptions and traffic; data-ookla-open-data-performance-tiles gives crowdsourced speeds for Uganda.
licence: not stated (only a site copyright notice on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
